sentences.text:

1

 Hon'Ble Vikram D. Chauhan, J. 
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned Aga for the State.
2.

This application has been filed by the applicant for setting aside the Non Bailable Warrant issued against the applicant on 22.02.2008 and the subsequent orders passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate (First), Allahabad in Complaint Case No. 951 of 2003 (State Versus Daya Shankar) under Sections 7 and 16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, Police Station Phoolpur, District Prayagraj (Allahabad).
3.
After some argument, learned counsel for the applicant states that he may be permitted to withdraw this application with liberty to file bail application before the court below.
4. Learned AGA has no objection to the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant.
5. Under the circumstances, the present application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to applicant to approach the court concerned for bail.
In order to enable the applicant to approach the court concerned for bail, for a period of 15 days, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
In case, the bail application is preferred by the applicant before the court concerned, the court concerned shall decide the same expeditiously without granting unnecessary adjournment to any party.
6. The application is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty and direction.

(Vikram D. Chauhan,J.) November 24, 2025 VMA  Daya Shankar Alias Daya Shankar Sahu vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 24 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101607742/
